messages:
tom: quick copy check — the latency donut tooltip currently says `p50 / p95`. PM flagged it as confusing for non-ML folks. should we spell out ‘median (p50)’ and ‘95th percentile (p95)’ or keep short?

maya: i vote for spelled out + paren short form. helps engineers and pm teams. accessibility wise full words are clearer :thumbsup:

eva: agreed. also can we add a micro-note about what it covers? e.g., ‘measurement window: last 5m, excludes retries’ — otherwise people assume global.

luis: one catch — tooltip width on small screens clips. if we make it longer, it might wrap weirdly. maybe keep primary line short and put details on a second, smaller line.

maya: proposal then: primary: `Median (p50) · 95th percentile (p95)` secondary/smaller: `Window: last 5m · Excludes retries`

tom: that looks good. can we see exact copy as a single tooltip string for engineers? also accessibility note for screen readers?

design-bot: recommended concise tooltip copy (2-line):
```
Median (p50) · 95th percentile (p95)
Window: last 5m · Excludes retries
```
Screen-reader alt: "Latency: median p50 and 95th percentile over the last five minutes, excludes retries."

eva: love the SR alt text. small nit: use ‘over the last 5 minutes’ (write out 5) for clarity in SR text?

maya: yeah do that. final SR: `Latency: median (p50) and 95th percentile (p95) over the last 5 minutes; excludes retries.`

luis: for responsive layout — devs, render as two stacked lines on <=420px, single-line with middot on >=421px. keeps UI consistent.

tom: awesome. i'll paste this into the PR and ping infra for the tooltip component update. thanks all :rocket:
